content:
Done. Here's the `CHANGELOG.md` skeleton created in the project root:

- **Header** with a brief description of the changelog purpose.
- **Format reference** based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/) and [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).
- **[Unreleased]** section with the standard change categories ready to be filled in:

| Category | Purpose |
|---|---|
| **Added** | New features |
| **Changed** | Changes in existing functionality |
| **Deprecated** | Soon-to-be-removed features |
| **Removed** | Removed features |
| **Fixed** | Bug fixes |
| **Security** | Vulnerability fixes |

As work progresses on this billing report project, entries can be added under the appropriate heading in `[Unreleased]`. When a release is cut, `[Unreleased]` stays at the top for ongoing work, and the current content gets tagged with a version number and date below it.
